name: Rebuild any website as code with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Rebuild any website as code from a form with MiroMiro

### How it works
A form that rebuilds any website as code. Paste a page into **Website Rebuild Form** and pick Tailwind, React, HTML + CSS or Vue. **Extract Hero and Find Sections** loads the page in a real browser, rebuilds the hero and lists every other section; **Extract Each Section as Code** rebuilds the rest. **Open the Rebuilt Page** sends the browser to the whole page assembled in order, with a Download HTML button. A section that fails is skipped, so one bad section does not stop the run. Failed calls are not charged.

### Setup
This template uses the verified community node **n8n-nodes-miromiro** (tested with version 0.1.4 on n8n 1.123).
1. On n8n Cloud, search "MiroMiro" in the nodes panel (an admin may need to turn on Verified Community Nodes). Self-hosted: Settings > Community nodes > Install `n8n-nodes-miromiro`, see https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/
2. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
3. Open **Extract Hero and Find Sections** > Credential > Create new, and paste the key.
4. Select the same credential in **Extract Each Section as Code**.
5. Open **Website Rebuild Form** and use its Test URL (or activate the workflow and use the Production URL).
6. Paste a page, pick the output and click Rebuild it.

Each section costs 10 credits, so a page of 6 to 12 sections is 60 to 120. The same page again within 24 hours is free.

### Customization
Add an email field and send the link instead of redirecting. Change `.slice(0, 12)` in **List Remaining Sections** to rebuild fewer sections. Share the production form with your team or clients.

![The workflow, in case the preview does not load](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoraiaBarroso/n8n-nodes-miromiro/main/docs/templates/rebuild-any-website-form.png)

parameters.formDescription: Paste a page. MiroMiro rebuilds every section as code and opens the result.

parameters.content:
## The form

Open the form URL, paste a page and pick the output.

## Find the sections

The first call rebuilds the hero and lists every other section.

## Rebuild and open

Each section becomes code (failed ones are skipped), then the browser opens the whole page assembled.
